images.observation: Actual specimen photos, complete eight-card grid, consistent readable labels and tap controls.

The enlarged cherry-leaf edge visibly retains real serrations and veins. Narrow-screen controls and the six-card grid remain readable without horizontal overflow.

Origin selection and its retained conceptual explanation render without source/provenance text or clipped labels.

Five mineral photos and clip observation are visible at tablet width; controls and observation rows remain readable.

Six specimens wrap into three columns; enlarged gneiss photo, pan/zoom controls and independent classification stack without clipping.

Tablet plots stack without shrinking the text. The upper-ocean temperature gradient and distinct actual sample depths are visible.

Missing salinity and density remain explicitly absent while the valid temperature is retained; no fabricated zero is drawn.
Narrow viewport stacks selectors, plots and readings. Controls remain touch-sized and graph labels stay at 14 screen pixels.
Same color scale in both seasonal maps; no artificial raster grid seams, aligned coordinate labels and readable fixed-pixel text.
Tablet difference view uses a symmetric zero-centered scale and preserves the same selected cell.

Original land mask gives missing readings and an empty annual curve instead of fabricated zero temperatures.
